title: Reconsideration of Value on an Appraisal Order
content:
### Reconsideration of value — Appraisal Order

Where the report type allows it, the borrower may ask the appraiser to reconsider the value. A request is accepted only when **all** of the following hold:

1. **Status.** A reconsideration of value is accepted only while the order status is delivered. This is read from Larkspur's record of the order the request challenges.
2. **Window.** A reconsideration of value is accepted only if it is submitted no later than the end of the reconsideration window that starts on the date the report was delivered to the borrower. Count calendar days forward from the date the report was delivered to the borrower, which is day zero; a request submitted on the last day of the window is accepted. The window length is the report type's reconsideration window in calendar days, and the delivery date is the one on Larkspur's record of the order.
3. **Limit.** An order accepts at most the report type's number of requests per order. Requests counted are those submitted on the order whose decision is not returned incomplete.
4. **Comparables.** A request resting on comparable sales must include at least the report type's minimum and no more than its maximum number of alternative sales. One that does not is returned incomplete, does not count against the limit and does not reopen the order.

A request raising valuation bias is accepted on the same terms and is also referred to Larkspur's fair lending officer.

**Outcome.** The appraiser responds within the report type's response period in business days. A decision that the value changed updates the appraised value to the revised value; a decision that the value is unchanged leaves it. The borrower is never charged for a reconsideration of value, and Larkspur never asks the appraiser to hit a target value.

#### Window — hypothetical boundary cases (14-day window)

| Report delivered to the borrower (day zero) | Request submitted | Day count | Accepted on the window test? |
|---|---|---|---|
| June 1 | June 15 | 14 | Yes — the last day of the window |
| June 1 | June 16 | 15 | No — after the window |

#### Limit — hypothetical case
An order whose report type accepts 1 request carries one earlier request that was returned incomplete for having no comparable sales on a comparable-sales ground. That request does not count, so a complete request inside the window on a delivered order is still within the limit.
